sign_convention: residual = observed - modelled; model pseudorange = range - c*dt_sv; s(t) = -c*dt_r. Spurious term -> a=-1; correct -> a=0; applied with wrong sign vs physics -> a=-2 (twice the term left); a=+1 would mean physics twice the applied term.
clock_projection: proj regressor = s_i - sum(w_j s_j)/sum(w_j) over the epoch's accepted members (exactly what solve_clock_only removes); raw regressor ignores absorption.

phase_b_g07.note: SNR = effective signal rms * sqrt(N) / per-epoch robust sigma; G07 solved-around so no clock absorption (retained frac 1.0). The ACF figure is the realistic one: residuals are correlated on ~tau minutes.
phase_b_g07.verdict: Phase B as planned (term OFF for G07, 24 h, solve-around) has the same physics sensitivity as Phase A on G07 alone: toggling the model shifts the expected residual shape by exactly c*dt_r (a: 0 -> -1 relabelled) and gains only the removal of clock absorption (0.87 -> 1.0). At the current floor (robust sigma 48 m GPS-wide, 39 m on G07; correlation time 6.5 min median, 15 min on G07) the per-pass amplitude SNR is 0.86 (ACF) / 2.2 (60 s) / 16.6 (iid, fictitious); two passes per day -> SNR ~1.2/day; ~3-4 days for 3 sigma, and that only if the systematics do not repeat sidereally (multipath does). Decisive alternative: carrier-phase (time-differenced) residual on G07 - d(dt_r)/dt peaks ~2.1 mm/s, accumulating ~7 m per hour against cm-level carrier noise.

fresh_pred_meaning: fresh = epoch had a fresh code (pseudorange) update from the tracker (~1/6 Hz staircase); pred = carrier-propagated pseudorange between code refreshes (examples/clock_bias.rs:333). 85% of GPS samples are pred, so independent code measurements arrive at ~0.17 Hz; iid errors are fictitious.
decisive_prns: none at the |a|~1 level; best single-PRN sensitivities (sigma_acf on a): G30 4.3, G07 7.0, G25 7.0, G02 7.1, G32 7.8
verdict: Combined a (proj. regressor, ok rows, ACF-based errors, inverse-variance over 23 PRNs) = -2.0 +/- 2.2 with linear per-PRN trend (chi2 21.5/22 -> error scale is right) and +0.04 +/- 1.98 with quadratic trend; fresh-only -2.0 +/- 2.3; rej included +0.8 +/- 2.1. Both hypotheses (a=0 applied-correctly, a=-1 spurious) lie inside 1 sigma: Phase A is NOT decisive. The naive iid (-3.9 +/- 0.11) and 60 s (-3.9 +/- 0.8) errors would falsely claim a many-sigma over-correction; the between-PRN chi2 (188/22 at 60 s) shows those errors are wrong. Cause: each PRN is seen for 1-3.3 h (<1/4 orbit) so the 12 h signature is degenerate with offset+slope, leaving a few metres of curvature against 40-60 m residual systematics correlated over ~6-15 min. Free sinusoid amplitudes (100-20000 m, errors of the same size) are unconstrained.
